summary: Read a text whose characters can only be opening or closing round, square, or curly brackets. Decide whether the brackets close in a fully correct way. Each opener must be finished by a closer of the same shape, a later opener must be finished before an earlier one, and pairs may not cross. A text with no characters counts as correct. Write true or false for the decision.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is one token of text without spaces.
